title: Saves
summary: How the server saves your campaign and its Burning Empires data.

sections.heading: Saving
steps: Save game saves while the server keeps running. Players stay connected.
Stop server and Restart save first, and wait until the save is really written.
When players are on, Restart warns them 30 and 10 seconds before.
Autosave minutes on the Settings page sets the autosave. 0 turns it off.

sections.heading: Burning Empires data
steps: Burning Empires keeps populations, religions and more outside the save, in your Burning Empires save data, a folder inside its module folder.
The tool keeps that folder when it updates the server, and moves it along when you rename, back up or restore a save.
If the server says it saved to a new name to keep your data safe, click Save to a new name and use that save from then on.

sections.heading: Picking a save
steps: Pick that save shows each save as Server copy, Single player copy or Other folder.
Browse save picks a save from another folder.
The server only loads a Server copy. For a Single player copy, click Name server copy first.
Delete server copy removes the server copy. Your Documents save stays as it is.
A save from another Burning Empires version shows a warning and asks before Start.
sections.tip: Under the save you see the character, level, campaign day and the mods written in the save.

sections.heading: Last good save
steps: Use it only when the log says your hero has no party to rejoin.
It puts back the newest save from before that happened and starts the server.
While the hero has no party, the tool does not save over your world.
